B1: You receive one video call of up to 60 minutes. We send one written read-out by email within 10 working days. Places go in the order complete applications arrive. Each company gets one place. This offer costs you nothing.
B2: There are 10 places. They go to complete applications by the date and time we receive them, first come, first served, and nothing else decides the order.

B3.heading: Your place status
B3.sentence: Within 2 working days, we send the confirmation email.

B4: A company that has had its audit or lost its place under these terms cannot apply again under a different name, a new trading name, or through another person.

B5.heading: Not for rival studios
B5.sentence: If we learn this afterwards, see clause 34 ({{H34}}).

B6: The waiting list closes when the offer ends. Everyone still on it is told by email within 5 working days, and their position ends without carrying over to any later offer unless we say so in writing.
B7: The audit does not cover design, writing, building, strategy, extra calls, or unlimited questions.
B8: Please give us honest and complete details

B9.heading: Give us true details
B9.sentence: If details turn out to be false, see clause 34 ({{H34}}).

B10: The audit is not legal, financial, tax, or accounting advice. Consult a qualified professional for these areas.
B11: You are under no obligation to buy anything.
B12: We limit ourselves to these five reasons and no others.
A pause is a short wait while we check whether a rule was really broken. During it you keep your place, and we give you a date by which you will hear the result.
B13: (2) Working for, or applying for, a competing studio, clause 5.
(3) Recording or sharing the call without agreement, clause 26.
(4) Reselling, publishing or misusing the read-out, clause 24.
(5) Rude, threatening or abusive behaviour towards anyone in the studio.

B14-1.heading: One chance per company
B14-1.sentence: Each company can take part in this offer one time.

B14-2.heading: Linked firms count as one
B14-2.sentence: If several companies share the same owner, group, or management team, they count as one company for this offer.

B14-4.heading: Who can fill the form
B14-4.sentence: The person filling in the form must be the owner, a director, or someone the owner has allowed to apply and share business details.

B14-8.heading: Not for resale
B14-8.sentence: The place cannot leave your company.

B14-14.heading: Final document
B14-14.sentence: The read-out is finished and not a draft.

B14-15.heading: New terms
B14-15.sentence: Paid work happens under a new and separate agreement.

B14-20.heading: Fixed end time
B14-20.sentence: The call ends at the booked time if you join late.

B14-25.heading: Public use
B14-25.sentence: Using our name, the read-out or quotes from it in marketing or the press needs our written permission first.

B14-26.heading: Consent required
B14-26.sentence: Both sides must agree before recording or sharing the call.

B14-30.heading: Who sees your details
B14-30.sentence: Only our audit team views your information, and we use it solely to prepare your audit.

B14-32.heading: Storage limit
B14-32.sentence: We keep material for 12 months, then delete it if you do not become a paid client.

B14-33.heading: Optional list
B14-33.sentence: We do not put you on a mailing list unless you say yes.

B14-37.heading: Full terms
B14-37.sentence: These terms and your confirmation email, which clause 7 ({{H7}}) defines, form the whole agreement for the audit.
